title: Consciousness tracks synchrony, not firing rate

statements.text: Field computing can only be implemented by neurons that fire synchronously, so consciousness should correlate with the synchrony of neural firing rather than with firing rates. In matter-based models synchrony is optional, in field theories it is obligatory.

sources.quote: consciousness should be highly correlated with the synchrony of neural firing rather than firing rates
it is only in the EM field theories that synchrony plays an obligatory role in consciousness information processing
